input.summary: Make the source code licence transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition
input.comment: [Playbook] Our position requires the licence to follow the business in an M&A transaction, so we made the Article 23 source code licence transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition of Customer and conformed the Section 23.5 transfer prohibition so it does not contradict that right. Affiliates are already covered because the defined \"Customer\" includes its Affiliates.

ops.oldText: a non-exclusive, non-transferable license, through the end of the Term,
ops.newText: a non-exclusive license, transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition of Customer without M&I's approval, through the end of the Term,

ops.oldText: (1) distribute, sell, transfer, assign or sublicense the source code or any parts thereof to any third party
ops.newText: (1) distribute, sell, transfer, assign or sublicense the source code or any parts thereof to any third party, other than a transfer to a successor permitted under Section 23.4
